cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_BINARY_DIR)
	message(FATAL_ERROR "In-tree builds are not supported. Run CMake from a separate directory: cmake -B build")
endif()

set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT OFF)
if(CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR)
	set(CMKR_ROOT_PROJECT ON)

	# Bootstrap cmkr and automatically regenerate CMakeLists.txt
	include("cmake/cmkr.cmake" OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
	if(CMKR_INCLUDE_RESULT)
		cmkr()
	endif()

	# Enable folder support
	set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY USE_FOLDERS ON)

	# Create a configure-time dependency on cmake.toml to improve IDE support
	set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS cmake.toml)
endif()

project(jaba
	LANGUAGES
		CXX
)

if(WIN32)
    enable_language(ASM_MASM)
endif()

# force a reconfigure (and re-run of cmkr's glob) whenever a file is added to or removed
# from src/, so new files get picked up without having to touch cmake.toml by hand
file(GLOB_RECURSE JABA_SOURCE_GLOB_CHECK CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.hpp" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.inl")

# Packages
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux") # linux
	find_package(JNI REQUIRED)

endif()
# Target: jaba
set(jaba_SOURCES
	cmake.toml
	"src/hook/hook.cpp"
	"src/hook/hook.hpp"
	"src/hook/jaba_hk_stub_elf.cpp"
	"src/hook/pending.cpp"
	"src/hook/pending.hpp"
	"src/jaba.cpp"
	"src/jaba.hpp"
	"src/jni/clazz.cpp"
	"src/jni/clazz.hpp"

	"src/jni/env.hpp"

	"src/jni/field.inl"

	"src/jni/mapping.hpp"
	"src/jni/member.hpp"
	"src/jni/method.hpp"
	"src/jni/method.inl"
	"src/jni/object.hpp"
	"src/jni/signature.hpp"
	"src/jni/types.hpp"
	"src/jni/wrap.hpp"
	"src/jvm/compiler.hpp"
	"src/jvm/deopt.hpp"
	"src/jvm/field.hpp"
	"src/jvm/jvm.cpp"
	"src/jvm/method.hpp"
	"src/jvm/type.hpp"
	"src/jvm/version.hpp"
	"src/jvm/vm_struct.cpp"
	"src/jvm/vm_struct.hpp"
	"src/util/fixed_string.hpp"
	"src/util/image.hpp"
	"src/util/scan.hpp"
	"src/util/zstring_view.hpp"
)

if(WIN32) # windows
	list(APPEND jaba_SOURCES
		"src/hook/jaba_hk_stub.asm"
		"tests/dllmain.cpp"
		"tests/java/java.hpp"
		"tests/util/log.cpp"
		"tests/util/log.hpp"
	)
endif()

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux") # linux
	list(APPEND jaba_SOURCES
		"tests/linux/test.cpp"
	)
endif()

add_library(jaba SHARED)

target_sources(jaba PRIVATE ${jaba_SOURCES})
source_group(TREE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} FILES ${jaba_SOURCES})

target_compile_features(jaba PUBLIC
	cxx_std_23
)

if(WIN32) # windows
	target_compile_options(jaba PUBLIC
		"/Zc:preprocessor"
	)
endif()

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux") # linux
	target_include_directories(jaba PUBLIC
		"tests/linux/include"
		${JNI_INCLUDE_DIRS}
	)
endif()

target_include_directories(jaba PUBLIC
	src
	tests
	vendor
	"vendor/pe/include"
)

if(WIN32) # windows
	target_link_libraries(jaba PUBLIC
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/jni/jvm.lib"
	)
endif()

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux") # linux
	target_link_libraries(jaba PUBLIC
		${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}
	)
endif()
